snippet.title: Seeking Dawn Gameplay  |  Oculus Rift
snippet.description:
Welcome to Seeking Dawn, a multiplayer survival VR adventure that takes you far beyond the solar system. Step into the shoes of a soldier searching for a missing allied squad and discovering a hostile alien planet, where predators roam freely and enemies are ruthless.

With up to three friends, collect resources, build up your base and craft an arsenal to fight your way through Feral creatures, hostile soldiers, and terrifying bosses, all to discover what lies at the heart of the world.
